scope: say references whose action code begins with sell_ in the first 437 bank rows
review_rule: Retain a sell reference only when it clearly states or enacts a completed sale of the stated quantity and good at the stated unit price. A quote, future offer, conditional handover, or ambiguous deal is insufficient.
excluded_note: The other 80 scoped rows are quarantined for regeneration. This also excludes multi-item lines that could be read as giving the unit price as the total.

special_cases.383: Take them and pay up still makes payment future, so the sale is not complete.
special_cases.433: You will receive the goods contradicts the claim that the sale is complete.
